rules.statement: In a repository generated from NCodeGroup's project-template, don't ask for hand edits to files the template update script (`Update-Project.ps1`) writes, such as `.claude/settings.json`; send the change to project-template instead.
rules.why: Template-merged files are rewritten on the next template update, so a local hand edit is lost or conflicts. The fix belongs in project-template, where every downstream repository picks it up.
rules.check: Before suggesting a change to a file like `.claude/settings.json`, check whether the template update script owns it. If it does, frame the finding as a project-template change, not an edit in this pull request.
